propagation_patterns.pattern: Leaked via Google (AS 15169) from provider AS 701 to peer AS 21395
Propagation through Tier-1 Orange (AS 5511) to downstream peers

path_inflation_analysis.notes: Route leak through Google (AS 15169) adds 3+ unnecessary transit hops via AS 701, significantly inflating the path length. Before the leak, prefix 5.206.240.0/20 was reachable via direct provider relationships (AS 9002, AS 3257).

geographic_analysis.propagation_scope: Global propagation through Tier-1 networks (701/Verizon, 5511/Orange) reaching observers in Europe (3333/RIPE, 8758/Switzerland) and Asia (4777/Japan)

impact_assessment.visibility: Medium - observed by 4 peer ASNs (3333, 29608, 4777, 8758) across Europe and Asia
impact_assessment.reachability_impact: Moderate - leaked paths route traffic through Google (AS 15169) instead of the normal provider AS 9002, potentially causing traffic interception and added latency
impact_assessment.duration_impact: Medium - approximately 40 minute duration (03:22 to 04:02 UTC)
impact_assessment.mitigation_difficulty: Medium - requires coordination with AS 701 (Verizon) to enforce prefix filters on AS 15169's announcements

recommendations: Notify AS 701 (Verizon/UUNET) to enforce prefix filtering on routes learned from AS 15169 (Google)
Coordinate with AS 15169 (Google) to implement proper route filtering policies preventing provider-to-peer leaks
Implement RPKI ROA for prefix 5.206.240.0/20 by AS 57332 to validate origin AS
Deploy BGP route leak detection systems (e.g., AS path consistency checks, max-prefix limits)
Monitor for similar patterns involving AS 15169 leaking provider routes to peers
